title: Design System: Trợ lý Kiểm định — Kỹ Nghệ Xanh

display.purpose: App title, panel section headers. One per surface. text-wrap: balance.

label.purpose: Button text, navigation tabs, sidebar group headings, sub-panel titles.

body.purpose: Chat message content, source document prose. Max ~65ch in prose.

meta.purpose: Timestamps, section paths, status labels, citation chip numbers.

doc.purpose: Source document viewer panel (.md-doc) only. Nowhere else.

shadows.name: structural-separation
shadows.purpose: App header and subtle structural cards at rest. Barely perceptible spatial marker.

shadows.name: source-card
shadows.purpose: Source document page card in the reading panel. The one deliberate elevation.

shadows.name: process-card
shadows.purpose: Process step thinking card shown during pipeline execution.

shadows.name: user-bubble
shadows.purpose: User chat bubble. Tinted to brand color, not neutral shadow.

motion.name: fadeUp
motion.value: translateY(7px) to translateY(0), opacity 0 to 1, 250ms ease-out
motion.purpose: All new messages and new UI elements entrance.

motion.name: hlGlow
motion.value: box-shadow pulse rgba(245,158,11,.22) 0px to 5px to 0px, 2.6s ease-in-out infinite
motion.purpose: Selected source passage amber pulse. The rgba value is motion-only, never used as fill.

motion.name: pulseDot
motion.purpose: Active status dot for LLM connection indicator.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: LLM checking spinner and process-step active-step spinner.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.notes: Multi-column collapses to single column; sidebar becomes fixed overlay; source panel stacks below chat at 50vh height.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Send and confirm actions. The single primary CTA per view.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="22" y1="2" x2="11" y2="13"/><polygon points="22 2 15 22 11 13 2 9 22 2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #16A34A; color: #fff; width: 46px; height: 46px; border: none; border-radius: 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 100ms ease; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #15803D; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #DCFCE7; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #CBD5E1; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions: new chat, open document.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg> Hội thoại mới</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #fff; color: #15803D; border: 1px solid #16A34A; border-radius: 9px; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F0FDF4; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #DCFCE7; }

components.name: Assistant Message Bubble
components.description: AI response zone. Light sage-green distinguishes it from white chrome.
components.html: Đây là câu trả lời từ trợ lý.
components.css: .ds-bubble-bot { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-bubble-bot__avatar { flex-shrink: 0; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #DCFCE7; border: 1px solid #BBF7D0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-bubble-bot__body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 13px 16px; border-radius: 16px 16px 16px 5px; background: #EDF8F2; border: 1px solid #C3DDD0; color: #1D2D23; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: User Message Bubble
components.description: User question in solid emerald. Visual counterpoint to bot zone.
components.html: Áp suất thử nghiệm van an toàn 1400 bar là bao nhiêu?
components.css: .ds-bubble-user { max-width: 80%; padding: 11px 15px; border-radius: 16px 16px 5px 16px; background: #16A34A; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(22,163,74,.22); margin-left: auto; }

components.name: Citation Chip
components.description: Inline clickable source reference in answer markdown.
components.css: .ds-cite-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 21px; height: 21px; padding: 0 5px; margin: 0 1px; vertical-align: -3px; background: #DCFCE7; border: 1px solid #86EFAC; color: #15803D; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-cite-chip:hover { background: #16A34A; color: #fff; border-color: #16A34A; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Chat composer textarea and search fields.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Nhập câu hỏi của bạn…" />
components.css: .ds-input { flex: 1; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; border-radius: 11px; padding: 0 15px; height: 46px; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.55; color: #1D2D23; background: #fff; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B7C72; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #16A34A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #DCFCE7; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: LLM connection status indicator in the header.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid; transition: filter 120ms ease; } .ds-status-pill--active { background: #F0FDF4; border-color: #BBF7D0; color: #15803D; } .ds-status-pill--checking { background: #FFFBEB; border-color: #FDE68A; color: #B45309; } .ds-status-pill--error { background: #FEF2F2; border-color: #FECACA; color: #DC2626; } .ds-status-pill--none { background: #F1F5F2; border-color: #DDE5E0; color: #6B7C72; } .ds-status-pill__dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-pill:hover { filter: brightness(0.97); }

narrative.overview: This interface is a precision tool, not a chat product. The metrologist arrives with an instrument and a procedure number; the interface must vanish into the lookup task within the first keystroke. The visual system is named Ky Nghe Xanh (Engineering Green) — a discipline of structured density, a single emerald accent, and a text scale where every gray leans sage-warm toward the brand rather than cold blue-slate.
keyCharacteristics: Single emerald accent on ≤10% of visible surface
Three-level surface hierarchy: canvas → white panels → tinted source panel
Warm sage text scale — all grays biased toward brand hue
Bot response bubbles as distinct AI zone (#EDF8F2 light sage-green)
Lora serif restricted exclusively to source-document reading pane
Formula fidelity as trust signal — full four-side borders, never left-side stripes

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Emerald is the only non-neutral color. Its rarity is the signal. A second decorative accent anywhere is prohibited.

rules.name: The Warm Gray Rule
rules.body: Every gray must sit on the warm-sage hue axis. Tailwind slate- (blue-gray) is prohibited for new surface or text colors.

rules.name: The Lora Containment Rule
rules.body: Lora is permitted in exactly one place: the .md-doc source reading panel. All other UI chrome uses Be Vietnam Pro.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Every surface ships flat or at structural-separation shadow. Source card lift appears only on the document page card.

rules.name: The No-Stripe Rule
rules.body: border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent on any element is absolutely prohibited.

dos: Use Emerald Active (#16A34A) on ≤10% of any screen
Give formula blocks full four-side borders (1px solid #DDE5E0) plus background tint
Set all gray text to the warm-sage scale (#3D5045, #6B7C72) — never Tailwind slate-500
Keep Lora serif to the .md-doc source reading pane only
Give bot response bubbles #EDF8F2 background and #C3DDD0 border consistently
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce on all CSS keyframe animations
Apply WCAG AA contrast to all text
donts: Don't use cool Tailwind slate grays (slate-500 #64748B, slate-700 #334155) for new colors
Don't introduce a second decorative accent color
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe
Don't use background-clip: text with gradient for headings
Don't make this look like a Vietnamese government portal
Don't make this look like a generic consumer chat clone
Don't use #9AAFA3 (Ink Faint) for any readable text
Don't use #000000 pure black — use Near-Black Sage #111B16
Don't add CDN-linked fonts — offline-first app
